clues.title: Landscape: green wooded hills, tall golden grass
text: Eswatini’s landscape is known for its **green, wooded hills** and **tall golden grass**.
NOTE: In contrast, Lesotho’s mountains are typically barren, and long grass is not a common sight there.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Green hills with trees and tall golden grass. Lesotho's mountains are bare and rarely have long grass.

differs.how: Bare, barren mountains with little long grass

clues.title: Pole: dark brown wood, side insulators
text: Poles in Eswatini are made of **dark brown wood** and follow a simple design. The insulators are mostly mounted on the side.
NOTE: In Southern Africa, three insulators on the pole are more commonly found in Eswatini.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Simple dark brown wooden poles with the insulators mounted on the side. Poles with three insulators on top are more common here than elsewhere in Southern Africa.

clues.title: Sign: road numbers starting with MR
text: Roads starting with the letters **“MR”** are exclusive to Eswatini.

images.caption: Green road sign with MR19 and the place names Mhlambanyatsi and Mbabane

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Road numbers that start with the letters MR only exist in this country.

clues.title: Road lines: yellow edges, triple white centre
text: Eswatini typically uses **yellow **outside lines and occasionally, **triple white **middle lines.
NOTE: Similar road lines can also be found in South Africa, Lesotho and Botswana.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Yellow lines at the edge of the road, and sometimes a triple white centre line. South Africa, Lesotho and Botswana use the same style.

clues.title: Google car: white car, no antenna
text: All of Eswatini was covered by a **white** Google car without an antenna.
NOTE: Within Africa, this car can also be found in South Africa, Lesotho and Botswana.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: The car is white with no antenna. South Africa, Lesotho and Botswana have this same car, so it only narrows the region.

clues.title: Plate: long, green strip at the bottom
text: Licence plates in Eswatini are **long** and **green at the bottom**.
NOTE: These may look similar to certain South African plates. Make sure to refer to other clues before guessing.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Long plates with a green strip along the bottom. Some South African plates look similar, so check other clues before guessing.

clues.title: Roadside: concrete bus shelters
text: **Concrete bus shelters** are a common sight on roads in Eswatini.

images.caption: A concrete bus shelter by the roadside

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Concrete bus shelters are common along the roads.

clues.title: Landscape: golden grass on western mountains
text: Montane grasslands with **long golden grass** and a mountainous landscape are typical of Western Eswatini.
NOTE: Long grass can be found in almost all areas of Eswatini. This clue refers specifically to the pristine golden colour most commonly seen in the Western highlands.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: In the west, mountains covered in pristine golden grass. Long grass grows nearly everywhere, but this clean golden colour is typical of the western highlands.

clues.title: Plants: pine plantations in the west
text: **Pine tree plantations** are found in select areas in the West of the country.
NOTE: Similar plantations can also be found in South Africa.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Pine plantations in a few western areas. South Africa has similar ones.

clues.title: Landscape: very dark green wooded mountains
text: This distinct region in the central South of the country, mostly along the MR9, can be recognized by the dark, overwhelming **greenness** and **tall wooded mountains**.
NOTE: If you are struggling to see why this is unique, try comparing this to other areas of the country, which are more “golden” and light-coloured.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: In the centre-south, mostly along the MR9, the hills are tall, wooded and a deep dark green. The rest of the country looks lighter and more golden.

clues.title: Landscape: unusually flat east, hills far away
text: You can recognise this region in the east of the country thanks to the **unusual flatness** and the mountains often visible in the distance.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: The east is unusually flat, with mountains often visible in the distance.

clues.title: Crops: sugar cane along the east border
text: **Sugar cane **is grown in several areas along the Eastern border.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Sugar cane fields appear in several places along the eastern border.

clues.title: Coverage: flat, dry grass, dirty camera
text: The MR3 South of Ngomane can be recognized thanks to flatness, long dry grass and the **dirt on the camera**.

images.caption: Flat dry grass and a dirty camera lens

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: On the MR3 south of Ngomane: flat land, long dry grass, and dirt on the camera lens.

clues.title: Guardrail: divided highway, metal and stone
text: The MR3 from Manzini to the South African border is **divided** by metal and stone guardrails, making it recognisable.
NOTE: This road is the only divided highway found in Eswatini.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: A road split by metal and stone guardrails, running from Manzini to the border. It is the only divided highway in the country.

clues.title: Landscape: distinct ridge to the east
text: The MR8 in Southeastern Eswatini straddling the South African border is recognisable because of this **distinct ridge to the east**.

images.caption: A distinct ridge on the horizon to the east

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: On the MR8 in the south-east, along the border, a clear ridge rises to the east.

clues.title: Landscape: savannah, narrow dirt tracks
text: You can recognise the **Mlawula Nature Reserve** thanks to the narrow dirt tracks, tall grass and overall savannah landscape.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: A nature reserve with narrow dirt tracks, tall grass and open savannah scenery.

clues.title: Language: Portuguese text in a border town
text: If you see **Portuguese** text in Eswatini, you are most likely in the small town of Lomahasha.
NOTE: This is because of its proximity to Mozambique, where Portuguese is spoken.

images.caption: A roadside sign with Portuguese text

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Portuguese writing most likely means a small town on the Mozambique border, where Portuguese is spoken.
